mechanism: St. John's wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing haloperidol metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations, while potentially lowering seizure threshold through additive CNS effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor for increased haloperidol toxicity (extrapyramidal symptoms, QT prolongation) and adjust haloperidol dosing downward; consider alternative antidepressant.
